regime: Forced selling in metals with silver under extra stress, a tech-led selloff and a volatility jump, while oil stays near six-month highs
takeaway: Gold fell about 3.4% to near $3,884, a one-year low, and silver dropped over 6% to under $49, pushing the gold/silver ratio to about 79; gold miners fell even harder. Stocks had their worst day since June as Intel and Amazon results revived worries about AI spending, the VIX jumped about 13%, and money moved into bonds. Brent settled near $118 on fears the Iran war could widen after the US midterms.
